name: Reuse Data Report Error 5
definition: Indicates a cancellation of a wrongly submitted entire report in case the contract never came into existence or was not subject to reporting requirements but was reported to a trade repository by mistake.

TechnicalRecordIdentification.name: Technical Record Identification
TechnicalRecordIdentification.definition: Unique identifier of a record in a message used as part of error management and status advice message.

ReportingDateTime.name: Reporting Date Time
ReportingDateTime.definition: Date and time of submission of the report to the entitled receiver.

Counterparty.name: Counterparty
Counterparty.definition: Data specific to counterparties and related fields.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
